text.description_html:
PDQ KV125IND26D, Standard Duty Commercial Restroom Deadbolt with Locked and Unlocked Indicator

This restroom occupancy indicator door bolt can be used on commercial bathroom doors such as those in an office. The deadbolt is thrown or retracted from the inside by a thumbturn. The occupancy indicator on the outside has either a symbol of a locked padlock in red or an unlocked padlock in green. It is great for high traffic bathrooms as no English is required to read it.

The Satin Chrome Restroom Lock with Occupancy Indicator is very easy to install. It will fit door thicknesses of 1-3/8 inches or 1-3/4 inches with backsets of either 2-3/8 inches or 2-3/4 inches--both of which are adjustable so you don't have to worry if you got the right size. Includes Safety Release Key for opening locked doors in emergency cases.

U.L., U.L.C. Listed, UL10C / UBC 7-2 (1997) positive pressure, UL10B Neutral Pressure Rated.

Specifications for the PDQ Restroom Occupancy Indicator Door Bolt:

  • Finish: Satin Chrome
  • Door Thickness: Adjustable for 1-3/8" to 1-3/4" thick.
  • Backsets: Adjustable 2-3/8 and 2-3/4"
  • Deadbolt: 1" brass throw with case-hardened roller pin.
  • Strike: 2-3/4" x 1-1/8"
  • Door Prop: 1-3/4" bore
  • Comes packaged with a emergency release key.
  • Package includes all necessary mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
